constants.similarity_calibration: PROVISIONAL — tuned synthetically; calibrate against registry corpus (631 entries, 2026-10-13) before production wiring

fail_closed: chosen door unknown or closed -> reroute to first open door; none open -> ValueError
MERGED lesson missing canonical_id at ELEVATE stage -> skip, record in cycle.flags, complete cycle
identical re-submission by same connection -> single record, duplicate=true, no stat inflation
zero-contribution connection -> compound_count 0, compounds [], no cross-connection leak

proof_cases.asserts: registration returns conn-* id on declared door; closed chosen door reroutes to an open door
proof_cases.name: G1-open-doors

proof_cases.asserts: append returns status INTAKE with zero gate
proof_cases.name: G2-instant-capture

proof_cases.asserts: >=1 compound cites the contributed lesson; cycle == the run cycle
proof_cases.name: G3-compound-recorded

proof_cases.asserts: identical re-submission -> one lesson id; no new compound; compound_count stays 0
proof_cases.name: polarity-dedupe-no-double-compound

proof_cases.asserts: MERGED lesson without canonical_id -> flagged in cycle.flags; cycle completes; zero compounds cite it
proof_cases.name: fail-closed-corrupted-merge

seam_upstream.note: B-47 declares doors against this registry; it does not re-specify door contracts (L16)

transitions.INTAKE->INTAKE: lone lesson after a cycle: stays INTAKE, never faked MERGED
transitions.INTAKE->MERGED: one cycle; member of a >=2 cluster with Jaccard >= MERGE_SIMILARITY; sets canonical_id = earliest-captured member
transitions.MERGED->ELEVATED: one cycle; canonical group size >= ELEVATE_MIN_CLUSTER and no prior ELEVATE compound for that canonical_id
